edit.archived: optional false default; explicit metadata namespace

production.preparation: Existing full Mutation, bounded job, writer/epoch/generation/fingerprint guards and original receipt reconciliation. No new route or transaction engine.
production.journal: Removal version 2 prevents protected older readers from silently consuming an interrupted deletion. New readers still recover ordinary version 1 journals.
production.commit: Strong selected metadata identity and SHA checked before durable intent. Authorized partial removals roll forward; foreign replacements and unrelated absence are preserved/refused. Durable original Completion precedes optional cleanup.
production.cleanup: Same shared EX lock, <=10000 directory entries, <=16MiB aggregate metadata and <=4096 retained paths. Active, archived and backup refs count; malformed/unsupported/unconfined refs preserve all candidate media. <=64 unique candidate files, no recursive media scan. Missing cleanup after interruption can leave orphans safely.
production.cleanup_failure: Never changes durable metadata success into a replayable failure; project copies and unrelated files remain outside removal.
production.receipt: Ordered deleted_ids and deleted_assets retained in ready result and original/recovered ACK; existing 4096-byte completion limit is enforced.
production.client: Delete, Backspace, Edit Delete and collapsed Asset actions share an accessible selection/revision-bound modal. Cancel is focused by default. Stale, readonly, pending, malformed and oversized requests cannot apply.
production.source: Validated ACK calls onRemoved even if the panel has closed; matching epoch/Library ID only. Matching pending resolution is aborted, matching Source resets to Program. Ordinary project Source remains intact.
production.project_undo: No project entities, generation, Saved state or history step is changed by Library removal.
